build_MBAC_init: build a python module to initialize an MBAC algorithm with an environment name, policy, and MPC parameters
create_collect_paths: create a function that collects trajectories using policy or MPC actions and returns observation and reward data
test_add_paths_to_buffer: test the MBAC add_paths_to_buffer method to append trajectories and enforce the buffer size limit
review_get_data_from_buffer: review the MBAC get_data_from_buffer method that concatenates observations and expert actions into PyTorch tensors
run_train_step: run the MBAC train_step method to collect paths, update the buffer, and fit the policy to expert actions
